caption: The drawing depicts a round, brown plate with a decorative design. In the center of the plate, there is a stylized bird rendered in shades of yellow and green, with distinct outlines and patterns on its body and tail. The bird features a crest on its head, a curved beak, and detailed, patterned wings and tail feathers. Encircling the bird, toward the rim of the plate, there is a band of text in a cursive script, written in a yellow color; sections of the text are interspersed with green vertical lines. The outermost edge of the plate has a repeating zigzag or sawtooth pattern in yellow. The plate sits on a neutral, light-colored background, and the artist’s signature, "W. L. Antrim," appears near the bottom right of the plate.
title: Pa. German Plate
